name: orche-omp-workflow
description: GitHub issue → verified PR workflow where Claude Code / Codex orchestrates and omp (oh-my-pi) executes: implementation, cross-review, and finding verification are delegated to omp implementer/reviewer/verifier sessions through codeagent-wrapper, while Phase 7 final review stays a native subagent. Mandatory OpenSpec fixtures, risk-adaptive review, CI, human-gated merge. Use when the issue loop should run on omp ("用 omp 跑这个 issue", "omp 实现 #XX"). Not for docs/spec-only work, hotfixes that skip review, or all-native runs (use subagent-workflow).
